sources.fullCitation: Allan Jones, tenor, with orchestra conducted by Nathaniel Shilkret. “Cosi Cosa.” Victor, Katalog-Nr. 4381, side marked B, 1938. The description gives the recording date as 13 January 1938 and identifies the side as the version Jones sang in the MGM film „Everybody Sings“, three years after he introduced the song in „A Night at the Opera“. Discographic detail as given in the uploader's description; the label is not shown in the YouTube upload.
